places.name: Fushimi Inari Shrine
places.ai_summary: A famous Shinto shrine known for its thousands of vermilion torii gates.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early morning to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for the hike up the mountain.

attribution.title: Torii path with lantern at Fushimi Inari Taisha Shrine, Kyoto, Japan
attribution.author: Basile Morin
attribution.description: Torii path with a hanging lantern at Fushimi Inari Taisha Shrine Senbontorii, Kyoto, Japan.

places.name: Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion)
places.ai_summary: A Zen Buddhist temple covered in gold leaf, surrounded by a beautiful pond and gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during autumn for the foliage.

places.place_tip: Visit early to capture the best photos without crowds.

attribution.title: Golden Pavilion Kinkaku-ji water mirror 2024
attribution.author: Nacaru
attribution.description: A picture of the golden pavilion at the Kinkaku-ji in 2024, with its structure mirrored on the water

places.name: Kiyomizu-dera Temple
places.ai_summary: A historic temple known for its wooden stage that offers stunning views of the cherry and maple trees below.

opening_hours.notes: The stage is particularly beautiful during the cherry blossom and autumn leaf seasons.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the Otowa Waterfall beneath the main hall.

places.name: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
places.ai_summary: A breathtaking bamboo forest that sways gently in the wind, creating a serene atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early in the morning or late in the afternoon.

places.place_tip: Respect the local wildlife and plants while visiting.

attribution.title: Arashiyama 013
attribution.author: Chris Spackman / TakuyaMurata at en.wikipedia
attribution.description: Mount Arashiyama across the Ōi River

places.name: Nijo Castle
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, this castle is famous for its beautiful gardens and historical significance.

opening_hours.notes: The gardens are especially beautiful in the cherry blossom season.

places.place_tip: Explore the Ninomaru Palace for its stunning interiors.

places.name: Gion District
places.ai_summary: The famous geisha district of Kyoto, known for its traditional wooden machiya houses and teahouses.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot to appreciate the architecture and atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Visit the teahouses for a chance to see geisha performances.

attribution.title: 150124 Gion Kyoto Japan01s3
attribution.author: 663highland
attribution.description: At Hanamikoji Street in Gion, Kyoto, Kyoto prefecture, Japan.

places.name: Philosopher’s Path
places.ai_summary: A pleasant walk along a cherry-tree-lined canal, this path is especially beautiful in spring.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the cherry blossom season.

places.place_tip: Start at the northern end and stroll southwards for the best views.

attribution.title: Japan Kyoto philosophers walk DSC00297
attribution.author: David Monniaux
attribution.description: the philosophers' walk in Kyōto, Japan

places.name: Nishiki Market
places.ai_summary: A vibrant market known as 'Kyoto's Kitchen', offering a variety of food, goods, and souvenirs.

opening_hours.notes: Try to visit on a weekday to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Sample local delicacies like yuba (tofu skin) and matcha sweets.

places.name: Tofuku-ji Temple
places.ai_summary: A renowned Zen temple famous for its stunning gardens and traditional architecture.

opening_hours.notes: The gardens are particularly beautiful in autumn.

places.place_tip: Explore the Hojo (abbot's quarters) for a glimpse of traditional Zen life.

places.name: Heian Shrine
places.ai_summary: A Shinto shrine noted for its beautiful gardens and traditional architecture.

opening_hours.notes: The gardens are especially beautiful in spring.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the garden's pond, which is particularly picturesque.

places.name: Ryoan-ji Zen Garden
places.ai_summary: A famous Zen garden known for its rock garden and serene atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning for a peaceful experience.

places.place_tip: Take your time to meditate and enjoy the tranquility.

attribution.title: Kare-sansui zen garden, Ryōan-ji, Kyoto 20190416 1
attribution.author: DXR
attribution.description: A view of the Kare-sansui (dry landscape) zen garden, Ryōan-ji, Kyoto

places.name: Pontocho Alley
places.ai_summary: A narrow alley famous for its traditional wooden machiya houses and vibrant nightlife.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening to experience the nightlife.

places.place_tip: Try to catch a glimpse of geisha or maiko (apprentice geisha) on their way to appointments.

attribution.title: Pontocho by Wolfiewolf in Nabeyacho, Kyoto

attribution.description: 先斗町（京都市中京区先斗町四条上ル鍋屋町付近）

places.name: Maruyama Park
places.ai_summary: A public park known for its cherry blossoms, especially beautiful in spring.

opening_hours.notes: The park is beautiful year-round, with cherry blossoms in spring and maple leaves in autumn.

places.place_tip: Visit the park's tea house for a traditional Japanese tea experience.

attribution.title: Cherry blossoms in Kyoto
attribution.author: Picturetokyo at English Wikipedia

places.name: Sanjusangendo Temple
places.ai_summary: A historic temple famous for its 1001 statues of Kannon, the Buddhist goddess of mercy.

opening_hours.notes: The temple is particularly serene in the early morning.

places.place_tip: Take your time to appreciate the intricate details of the statues.

places.name: Ginkaku-ji (Silver Pavilion)
places.ai_summary: A Zen temple at the foot of Kyoto's eastern mountains, known for its beautiful gardens and silver-covered pavilion.

opening_hours.notes: The garden's moss and sand landscapes are best appreciated in person.

places.place_tip: Visit the Silver Pavilion for its unique architecture and serene gardens.

attribution.title: Ginkakuji Kyoto03-r
attribution.author: Oilstreet
attribution.description: en:Ginkaku-ji (銀閣寺), Kyoto, Kyoto prefecture, Japan

places.name: Byodo-in Temple
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, this temple is famous for its Phoenix Hall, a masterpiece of Buddhist architecture.

opening_hours.notes: The temple is particularly stunning during the cherry blossom season.

places.place_tip: Explore the temple's museum for a deeper understanding of its history.

attribution.author: Martin Falbisoner
attribution.description: Byōdō-in's Phoenix Hall in Uji, Kyoto prefecture, Japan. It was built in 1153. Byōdō-in is registered as part of UNESCO World Heritage Site Ref. Number 688.

places.name: Yasaka Shrine
places.ai_summary: A famous Shinto shrine in the Gion district, known for its vibrant vermilion gates and annual festivals.

opening_hours.notes: The shrine is beautifully illuminated at night.

places.place_tip: Participate in the evening lantern ceremony if visiting in summer.

places.name: Sagano Romantic Train
places.ai_summary: A scenic train ride through the picturesque Hozu River gorge, especially beautiful in autumn.

opening_hours.notes: Advance reservations are recommended, especially in autumn.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the view of the changing leaves from the train.

places.name: Kyoto Imperial Palace
places.ai_summary: The former ruling palace of the Emperor of Japan, set in a large park with beautiful gardens.

opening_hours.notes: The palace grounds are closed to the public on certain holidays.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn more about the palace's history.

places.name: Higashiyama District
places.ai_summary: A historic district with preserved temples, traditional wooden houses, and charming streets.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot to appreciate the historical architecture.

places.place_tip: Visit the Kiyomizu-dera Temple and stroll along the Philosopher’s Path.
